name: Yacht and boat charters

problems.words: Same yacht booked twice for Friday evening
quick_ideas: Put every booking for the coming weeks on one calendar per vessel, so clashes show now
Let only one person confirm bookings for now, so two staff can't sell the same slot.

workzap_build.text: a central booking calendar per vessel that takes bookings from staff, website and platforms and blocks double bookings automatically.

problems.words: Brokers sell our boats cheaper than we do

Share one current rate sheet with every broker, so nobody is working from old prices.

workzap_build.text: a channel rate sheet shared with brokers, with regular price-parity checks flagging anyone below your rates.

quick_ideas: Put last month's bookings by day and boat side by side, so the gaps are clear

problems.words: Weather cancellations mean refund or rescheduling fights

never_say: Any maritime safety, seaworthiness, weather or sea-state go/no-go, life-jacket or equipment advice; that stays with the captain and the authorities. Any reading of maritime authority, coast guard or Transport Canada rules, or help operating without licences or above capacity. Legal views on alcohol on board or on cancellation terms; suggest they talk to their lawyer. Tax or financial advice for managed yacht owners. Fake reviews or misleading photos, and any storage of guests' names, passport or Emirates ID numbers, card details or crew licence data.

sample_reply.person: Two groups showed up for the same yacht last Friday because sales staff each keep their own sheet and platforms send emails. How do we stop this?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be stopped, and the first step is one calendar per boat. 1. Put every upcoming booking onto a single calendar per vessel this week, so any clash shows up now rather than on the dock. 2. Let one person confirm bookings until that's in place, so two staff can't sell the same slot. Workzap can do this automatically for you: one booking calendar per vessel that takes bookings from staff, your website and the platforms, and blocks a second booking for the same slot. Shall I put together a solution document and quote for you? You're free to say no.
